2609.03940.title: Masked Autoregressive Speech Enhancement with Continuous Neural Audio Codec Representations
2609.03940.paper_summary: Most previous work on speech enhancement (SE) based on masked generative modeling relied on discrete token representations of audio signals, obtained using neural audio codecs (NACs). However, a recent study has shown that continuous latent representations of NACs can be advantageous for SE in terms of speech quality and intelligibility. In this work, we propose masked autoregressive SE (MARSE), a method for SE based on iterative decoding of masked clean speech frames using continuous NAC representations of speech. In particular, we investigate a set of different decoding policies, ceteris paribus, that is, using the same DNN (a Conformer model), the same NAC (the DAC codec) and the same training setup. The results show that MARSE enables a flexible trade-off between SE performance and computational cost. Audio examples and code are available online.
2609.03940.paper_summary_zh: 大多數基於遮罩生成建模的語音增強（SE）先前的研究依賴於使用神經音頻編解碼器（NAC）獲得的音頻信號的離散標記表示。<lb/>然而，最近的一項研究顯示，NAC的連續潛在表示在語音質量和可懂性方面對SE是有利的。<lb/>在本研究中，我們提出了遮罩自回歸SE（MARSE），這是一種基於使用語音的連續NAC表示對遮罩乾淨語音幀進行迭代解碼的SE方法。<lb/>特別是，我們研究了一組不同的解碼策略，其他條件不變，即使用相同的DNN（Conformer模型）、相同的NAC（DAC編解碼器）和相同的訓練設置。<lb/>結果顯示，MARSE能夠在SE性能和計算成本之間實現靈活的權衡。<lb/>音頻範例和代碼可在線獲得。
